author: fwyzard
body:
#### PR description:

Declare `phase1PixelTopology::layerStart` as `HOST_DEVICE_CONSTANT`, like `phase2PixelTopology::layerStart`, so that device code that reads it through `pixelTopology::Phase1::layerStart` (for example `findLayer<Phase1>`) reads a device copy of the array.

#### PR validation:

Unit tests pass.

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

Backport of #52648.
title: [17.1] Make `phase1PixelTopology::layerStart` available in device code
